title: Inventory Labeler pricing decision
content: Decision: flat $2k for the Inventory Labeler app, client Acme Devices, stack Rust + Postgres, device grading workflow.

title: Supplier Parser demo shipped to Vercel
content: Supplier Parser proof demo deployed to supplier-parser-demo.vercel.app. Client contact reviewed login flow, pricing proposal ready.

title: Dev Server disk cleanup
content: Dev Server root disk /dev/vda1 was 100 percent full and cleanup reduced it to 76 percent. Memory API depends on the dev server.

title: Voice Assistant migration blocker
content: Voice Assistant migration from provider X to provider Y is blocked because BYOT is required. Keep the prompt-sync layer intact.

title: Media Pipeline image-to-video step
content: Media Pipeline uses ImageGen API with reference-driven motion transfer for short-form reels. The pipeline runs through the viral-reels producer skill.

title: Inventory Labeler receipt upload correction
content: User correction: Inventory Labeler must accept both PDF and a low-quality receipt photo; the parser should handle both formats.

title: Internal CRM task lookup source
content: Internal CRM tasks live in PostgreSQL on the Dev Server, not GitHub Issues or Linear. Agents should query the database first.

title: Cross-agent sync live
content: Mnemonic sends every memory to the shared Memory API on the Dev Server so agents A, B, and C can search the same store.

title: ConsultingCo service pricing
content: ConsultingCo strategy is service, not DIY. Personal tier starts at $500, Business tier starts at $2000, security is a selling point.

title: Mnemonic retrieval architecture
content: Mnemonic retrieval now fuses BM25, HNSW vector search, and graph hop via RRF. Whisper context prints source citations.
